settings.heading: 8x10 Area Rugs That Make a Room Feel Right
settings.row_content:
You know that feeling when a room is almost there?

The sofa’s right. The light’s good. The walls are done.
But somehow, it still feels unfinished.

Most of the time, it’s the floor.

An 8x10 area rug does something quiet but powerful. It pulls everything together. It gives furniture a place to sit. It makes the room feel lived in - not staged.

This is the size people come back for once they’ve tried it.

At Indian Rug Store, every 8x10 rug is handmade in Jaipur. Not in a factory. Not outsourced halfway across the world. In real workshops, by weavers we’ve worked with since 1990. Same city. Same looms. Many of the same families.

settings.heading: Why an 8x10 Floor Rug Just Works
settings.row_content:
There’s a reason designers love this size - but you don’t need to be one to feel the difference.

An 8x10 rug:

  • Anchors your sofa, chairs, and table into one calm space

  • Makes a living room feel intentional instead of “collected over time”

  • Sits perfectly under a queen or king bed

  • Works under a dining table without chairs slipping off the edge

  • Adds warmth without crowding the room

It doesn’t shout for attention. It settles things down.

settings.heading: Handmade in Jaipur. Slowly. Properly.
settings.row_content:
Close your eyes for a second.

Picture a quiet workshop in Jaipur. Morning chai. Wool yarn hanging to dry. A loom that’s been repaired more times than replaced.

Now imagine a weaver leaning in, tying knot after knot by hand. Thousands of them. Each one checked. Trimmed. Felt.

That’s how our Jaipur handmade rugs are made.

No shortcuts. No machines pretending to be human.
Just skill passed down through years of doing the same work, day after day.

This is why our handmade Indian rugs feel different when you walk on them. Not perfect. But honest.

settings.heading: How to Place an 8x10 Area Rug (Without Overthinking It)
settings.row_content:
You don’t need rules. Just a few simple ideas:

  • In the living room, let the front legs of furniture sit on the rug

  • In the bedroom, slide the rug under the bed so it shows on all sides

  • Under a dining table, make sure chairs stay on the rug when pulled out

  • In open homes, use the rug to quietly define a space

settings.heading: What size is an 8×10 rug?
settings.row_content: An 8×10 area rug measures 8 feet by 10 feet (96″ × 120″), one of the most popular rug sizes for medium to large spaces.

settings.heading: What rooms work best with an 8×10 rug?
settings.row_content: 8×10 rugs fit well in living rooms, dining areas, and bedrooms, anchoring furniture without overwhelming the space.

settings.heading: Can an 8×10 rug fit under a dining table?
settings.row_content: Yes, an 8×10 typically fits most 6- to 8-seat tables and gives room for chairs to stay on the rug when pulled out.

settings.heading: Should an 8×10 rug go under a bed?
settings.row_content: Yes. Position it under the bed so it shows on all sides, giving soft landings in bedrooms.

settings.heading: How much floor should show around an 8×10 rug?
settings.row_content: Leave a visible border of floor around the rug (often 6–18″) for balance and proportion.
